fourthdimension.telemetry.title: Fourth Dimension Ride
fourthdimension.ponder.family_arrow.head: Arrow controlled rotation
fourthdimension.ponder.family_arrow.text: Build with the matching family track and car. The colored strip is a schematic track centerline.
Two independent two-seat carriers share each chassis. Keep the rotating envelope clear.
Author rotation keys before placing cars. Adjacent sections must match unwrapped angle and slope.
Stop, capture and align all carriers before boarding. Close restraints and release maintenance retention before dispatch.
Appearance never changes track eligibility. A locked car still requires its matching functional track.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_legacy.tex: Build with the matching family track and car. The colored strip is a schematic track centerline.
Two independent four-seat carriers rotate freely. Leave platforms outside their swept envelope.
Gravity, motion and loading turn the carriers. Tune damping and ballast only while empty and captured.
Stop, capture and align all carriers before boarding. Close restraints and release maintenance retention before dispatch.
Appearance never changes track eligibility. A locked car still requires its matching functional track.
Build with the matching family track and car. The colored strip is a schematic track centerline.
Four independent carrier pairs share one chassis. Leave the full rotating envelope clear.
Orange inducer spans exchange forward energy for spin. Cyan dampers reduce rotation. Targets select carrier pairs.
Stop, capture and align all carriers before boarding. Close restraints and release maintenance retention before dispatch.
Appearance never changes track eligibility. A locked car still requires its matching functional track.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_revised.te: Build with the matching family track and car. The colored strip is a schematic track centerline.
Four independent carrier pairs share one chassis. Leave the full rotating envelope clear.
The revised carrier uses an offset pivot and more clearance. Its four-pair layout is an original game approximation.
Stop, capture and align all carriers before boarding. Close restraints and release maintenance retention before dispatch.
Appearance never changes track eligibility. A locked car still requires its matching functional track.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_1: Build with the matching family track and car. The colored strip is a schematic track centerline.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_2: Two independent two-seat carriers share each chassis. Keep the rotating envelope clear.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_3: Bind up to four coupled PAX cars to a powered Shuttle Winch. Close every restraint before starting.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_4: The mechanical catch lifts the train with carriers captured. At release, gravity drives the train.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_5: Carriers rotate after release. Restraints stay closed through every outward and return station pass.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_6: Wait for final capture before unloading. An interrupted cycle requires inspection and explicit resume or recovery.
fourthdimension.ponder.family_pax.text_7: Appearance never changes track eligibility. A locked car still requires its matching functional track.
fourthdimension.ponder.station_operation: Use the Boarding Station to bind a nearby car. Sneak-use rebinds it; normal operation requires the car within eight blocks.
Rear power requests capture. The front signal reports boarding alignment; the right reports closed restraints.
Close restraints using the Rotation Tool. Dispatch requires every linked car aligned, restrained, supported and released from maintenance retention.
Remove rear power to request dispatch. Use goggles or a Display Link for dispatch readiness and the reason a request is blocked.
Operate PAX through its Shuttle Winch. Ordinary station redstone cannot interrupt its catch, lift and return sequence.
